items.text: The Basement. Something has happened. You weren't there. Neither was I. Officially.
Time for The Basement. Our investigative strand. We've never solved anything, but we keep trying.
Each of you has evidence on your device. Some of it matters. Some of it doesn't. Talk it through, then each of you files your own theory.
You may investigate. Not much. We have a budget. Share what you like. Or don't. I'll be watching your faces.
This was reported to us this week.
Read it. Then look at your evidence. Then talk.
Time's up. File your theories. On your own. No conferring now.
Enough talk. What do you each think happened?
You all agree. That's either very good police work or a very loud person.
Unanimous. Let's see if you're unanimously wrong.
You don't agree. Interesting. Somebody's been quiet.
A split jury. Let's find out who was listening.
We never found out. We stopped asking.
And that's as far as anyone got.
That's The Basement. Please don't go down there.
